summary: Completed testing of new features: 2 new visa types (Transit 48h, Freelancer 2y), 6 new FAQ entries (total 17), legal pages (/iade-kosullari, /hizmet-sozlesmesi), bank transfer payment option with admin confirmation, promo banner, WhatsApp/email alternative application section, and hero redesign with marquee. Backend API tests: 67/73 passed (91.8%). Frontend tests: all new UI elements render correctly on desktop and mobile.

detailed_notes.regression_status: All existing features tested via backend API continue to work: multi-traveler pricing, Stripe checkout, admin CRUD operations, AI passport OCR, blog articles, testimonials, WhatsApp link generation
